worldcombat.skill.secretpower.summary: A short borrowed strike that takes the ground under the hit: fire ignites, plants lull to sleep, water and rain conduct paralysis, otherwise a plain hit. The direct form trades the site's effect for higher power. Aim at a target or just dash in one direction.
worldcombat.skill.secretpower.descriptio: Lunges up to %2$s blocks along the aim (about %3$s blocks/tick); the first enemy caught by the about %4$s-block sweep takes about %1$s contact damage and is shoved about %5$s blocks further along the lunge; a wall, the end of the distance or an empty aim stops it with no damage.

On a hit the site under the target decides the secondary status: fire to burn, plants to sleep, water or rain to paralysis, otherwise paralysis; chance %1$s, doubled in water or rain. The direct form ignores the site, always rolls paralysis and gets no doubling.
worldcombat.skill.secretpower.timing: Windup %1$s s, recovery %2$s s, cooldown %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.secretpower.preference: On: ignore the site, hit harder and always roll paralysis. Off: borrow the site, lower base power but can ignite, lull or conduct.
Only attack within this distance; farther targets are left to the shared approach logic.
When on, a stationed companion leaves its post to borrow the site; when off it stays put.
Skip targets already afflicted by this hit's status
When on, the move is held back only when the target already carries the status this hit's site would apply; other statuses on the target do not stop it.
worldcombat.skill.secretpower.descriptio: Burn halves the target's physical attack and costs it one-sixteenth of its maximum health about every 5 seconds for about 40 seconds, with Fire types immune; sleep leaves it unable to move or act and wakes it when damaged, for about 3 to 6 seconds; paralysis halves its movement speed and fails about one attempt in four for about 40 seconds, with Electric types immune.
